name: rabbitt-showreel
description: The 30-second landing-page showreel ("the hat trick"), rendered to MP4 with Remotion. Output: ../public/showreel/

scripts.render: npm run frames && npm run encode
scripts.frames: remotion render src/index.ts Showreel out/seq/h --sequence --image-format=png --scale=4 && remotion render src/index.ts ShowreelVertical out/seq/v --sequence --image-format=png --scale=4
